local_duplicate_review_notes: Independent centered-component comparison confirms the same geometry as 003: nearest-vertex error below 0.02 micrometers for the slab, 0.003 micrometers for knobs and 1.91 micrometers for the frame. Relative to the slab the frame shifts 9.98 mm, knobs shift 10.88 mm horizontally and 9.22 mm vertically. These small placement and atlas changes do not define a separate corpus geometry.
local_asset_shape_review_notes: Single plain metal leaf, two-sided knobs and its own source U-frame; visually different atlas region from 003.
local_mechanical_review_notes: Not rerun: held as a geometry variant of 003, which is now prepared. This is not a finding of physical unusability.
local_visual_review_notes: Original source geometry/atlas reviewed for duplication; no prepared variant or RTX captures generated.
